cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Shale & E&P lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +7.49%; weakest is Shale & E&P at -1.82%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: ARRY is the standout at +23.16%
cards.body: Leaders: ARRY +23.16%, BE +11.46%, ENPH +8.96%, SEDG +8.92%, EOSE +7.96%. Laggards: FANG -3.70%, MPLX -2.27%, APA -2.15%, PEG -2.11%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.

cards.headline: ARRY moving on no clear catalyst
cards.body: ARRY is +23.42% with no fresh headline this cycle — attention without a story. Volume, not news, is doing the work.
